notes: Working separate Outlaw accounts and shared comments/replies, editing/deleting, spoilers, sorting and votes. Matching title-page positioning, cast before trailers, in-site actor biographies/filmographies, production metadata, poster hover overlays, search result sizing, self-hosted Inter font and closer silk animation. Removed external title database links and source/status clutter. R2 media and account-free playback preserved. Public lists can be published, searched, opened without an account, copied, updated and made private. Cloud settings/list/progress sync preserves pending changes through refresh. Native media downloads stream with attachment and range headers. Exact reference curated rows and provider selections included. Cleaner title URLs preserve old links; refined hover motion, actor biography layout, Outlaw favicon and ranked source directory. ScreenScape, Cinextream and VidCore promoted for movies after fresh sandbox playback observations; TV compatibility is not assumed. Custom accessible preference menus and segmented controls; draggable/keyboard source ordering; clearer Febbox help; unified native player settings overview with actual quality/audio information. Homepage matched against reference measurements: 85vh hero with artwork bleed and viewport ambient colors, white timed slide indicators, rounded-square providers, expanded continue-watching previews and functional recommendation/provider selectors.
name: Outlaw Movies
